name: Conditional Execution
description: When its yes/no option (usually linked to a project parameter) is on, starts a separate run of the listed blocks of a project; when it is off, does nothing.
introductoryText:
Starts a separate run of some blocks of a project, this one or another, **only when the option Run the blocks is on**. Link that option to a yes/no project parameter, and whoever sets the parameter (a report view, the scheduler, the REST API or another block) decides whether the blocks run.

**Setting up**

1. Give the project's address, ending in .iox, for example `http://127.0.0.1:24679/Folder/Project.iox/`.
2. List the blocks to run, separated by commas.
3. Link *Run the blocks* to a project parameter.

The block asks the server to start the blocks and finishes straight away: it does not wait for them or report how they went. A run of that project already in progress is cancelled so that the new one can start. The user needs the *Workflow Execution via APIs* permission.

To choose a branch of this workflow from the data, use the core **If Then Split** or **Output Router** blocks instead.

options.name: Iox_File_Url
options.title: Project address
options.description: The address of the project whose blocks to run, ending in .iox. On the same server, the internal address such as http://127.0.0.1:24679/Folder/Project.iox/ avoids the public address and its certificate. A report or workflow address of the project is cut back to the project.

options.name: username
options.title: Username
options.description: Optional. For a server that asks for sign-in with a list of users: sent with basic authentication. Leave empty when no sign-in is needed.

options.name: password
options.title: Password
options.description: Optional. The password for the username.

options.name: execute
options.title: Run the blocks
options.description: On: start the blocks. Off: do nothing. Link it to a yes/no project parameter to switch it from outside the workflow.

options.name: Block_Names
options.title: Blocks to run
options.description: Names of the blocks to start, separated by commas. Blocks they depend on run too when needed.

options.name: Refresh_From_Source
options.title: Refresh from source
options.description: Reload the data from the sources, rather than reuse data the blocks already hold.
